name: Sculpfun iCube Pro 5W
tagline: 5W Compact enclosed Sculpfun — small footprint, full safety cabinet
tldr: Sculpfun iCube Pro 5W is the 5W SKU on the Sculpfun sculpfun icube pro line. Sculpfun's enclosed desktop laser for makers who want the brand's cutting performance in a safer cabinet. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Entry-level hobby engraving on wood, leather, and coated metal with light cutting

priceRange.note: 5W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Enclosed Sculpfun performance in compact box
Less smoke in room vs open S30
Fits desks that cannot fit open-frame 400 mm machines
cons: Small work area vs open Sculpfun models
Not cheaper enough vs open S30 to ignore bed size loss
beginnerNotes: Choose 5W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Use Sculpfun community presets as starting points — dial back 10–15% speed inside enclosure if char increases due to heat buildup.
primaryUse: Compact enclosed diode for small-space home offices doing engraving and light cuts on wood and leather.
